source: Nuxt Fonts resolves fonts from several web font providers, such as {0}Google Fonts{/0}, {1}Bunny Fonts{/1}, {2}Fontshare{/2}, and {3}Fontsource{/3}. You don't need to configure them: the first provider that has the font serves it.
